title: aeonium × velutinum
intro: Aeonium × velutinum, commonly known as the Velvet Aeonium, is a hybrid succulent plant that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. The health benefits of Aeonium × velutinum include its ability to act as a natural antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of bacteria. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to calm the mind and body, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular choice for aromatherapy and herbal remedies. Bioactive constituents of Aeonium × velutinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
